## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of LICENSE.txt.
- [x] I ran pre-commit on the changed files.
- [x] I reviewed the applicable AGENTS.md hard rules.
- [x] Labels: cat-bugfix, area:global_attention, area:frost, orig-nv-eng (requested from maintainers).

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels / CuTeDSL SDPA.

## Summary

Use lane zero as the stable K/V producer in the SM120 half-precision and MXFP8 prefill load helpers.

## Why

Repeated leader elections across successive K/V loads can expose optimization-sensitive divergent control flow on older PTX assemblers. These helpers are called by a complete producer warp, so a fixed live lane provides one issuer for both loads. Existing CTA barriers continue to gate pipeline reuse.

## Related issues

None.

## API and compatibility impact

No public API, dependency, architecture-admission, launch-geometry, or optimization-level changes. Transaction counts, TMA coordinates, scale copies, and barrier initialization are unchanged. The shared election primitive retains its existing semantics.

## Testing

- Compile-only checks for all eight edited-helper K/V and envelope/exact specializations passed.
- Formatting and license checks passed: black, black-jupyter, and SPDX headers.
- Both targeted SM120 numerical regression tests passed on this revision using a fresh source build and default optimization.
- Full-kernel compilation for both affected head dimensions passed.
